item.title: SEC charges former hedge fund manager with insider trading ahead of merger announcements
item.description: The Securities and Exchange Commission today filed charges alleging $4 million in illicit profits.

item.title: SEC publishes proposed rule on settlement disclosures for broker-dealers
item.description: The proposed rule would require broker-dealers to disclose settlement failures (excluded by the SEC enforcement rule).
